replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
I really don't see a need for this. If you are not getting new players then even having a lot of donor perks won't help that much. The server needs advertisement and has to give players a reason to stay playing. Giving donor ranks perks that affect gameplay are probably not the best idea with the already existing "skill barrier".

I've seen this on a lot of threads and it is that everyone seems to know how much money Avicus / Kylo has. Oh its going to run out of funds! How do you know?

The issue is advertising and not adding more perks. More perks would have people buy the ranks but if theres no new players coming, there won't be anyone to buy the ranks.

Also the EULA is here.

replies.body: A lot of servers do. Even servers like Hypixel started to after what happened just in case and theres no reason not to. You don't need to violate the EULA to have a popular server. Mineplex, Hypixel and such stopped violating it and are still standing really strong.

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
Those servers would be closed by now if Mojang actually decided to do something and enforce the EULA more.

More players won't join because you don't obey the EULA and have kits in the shop. If anything people will leave if the kits are too OP. 

Even if Avicus decides not to follow the EULA and adds shop perks that affect gameplay they won't get that many more packages sold since theres barely any new players joining that actually stick around and come on the website. Who will buy the perks if noone is joining? Maybe some people that have been here for a while but after some time that will stop so without advertising theres no point in having huge perks for donors if noone will buy them.
